title: 自动微分机制与边界

notebook.execution_method: Fresh Python process; actual ipykernel InProcessKernel, sequential cells and saved outputs

visual_review.notes: Improved dark heatmap text contrast, escaped Markdown multiplication signs, added Hessian definition and NumPy reflected-operator explanation, and kept exercises together. All changed final pages re-rendered and individually viewed; unchanged pages pixel-identical to earlier fully viewed render.

scope_limits: First-order CPU NumPy teaching engine with limited operations; no JAX/PyTorch execution in028.
Synthetic differentiation objective may be negative; not a supervised loss, training study or generalization result.
Non-smooth local conventions and detach barriers need explicit interpretation; they need not equal ordinary derivatives of equivalent forward functions.
Second derivative demonstration manually rebuilds the symbolic derivative expression; engine does not automatically construct a derivative graph.
Each vjp call returns a fresh gradient map and requires an exact-shape seed for non-scalar outputs.
Input/operation limits are separate caps, not an overall memory budget; floating rounding still occurs.
Private internal mutation is unsupported; defensive public value copies are tested.
All validation/calculation/serialization precede writes; no OS multi-file crash transaction or hostile concurrent path defense.
Fresh Anaconda installation, browser Jupyter, external socket kernels, GPU and cross-platform setups were not tested.
Strict default teaching file hashes can reject platform last-digit differences.
